custom_pokedex_text_review.gMagikarpKantonianPokedexText: This ancestral dragon thrives in depths warmed by CINNABAR magma. It needs no evolution. Hot water ripples behind its fins.
custom_pokedex_text_review.gOmatoPokedexText: A HELIX shell shelters a pale body restored from DART fragments. It probes cracks with its limbs, retreating at the slightest tremor.
custom_pokedex_text_review.gOmatopsPokedexText: It spins on its pointed shell, sweeping small scythes around its body. They pry shellfish from rocks for it to eat.
custom_pokedex_text_review.gMimeSrPokedexText: It shelters young mimes behind invisible walls shaped with small gestures. Even at rest, one hand guards the entrance.
custom_pokedex_text_review.gOsscythePokedexText: Grief binds it to old resting places. It sharpens its scythe-like limb on stone and stands watch after mourners have left.
custom_pokedex_text_review.gFeebasKantonianPokedexText: This ancestral dragon needs no evolution. Pale scales hide it in icy depths along cold currents from SEAFOAM ISLANDS.
custom_pokedex_text_review.gKabustarPokedexText: A DOME shell covers a blue body restored from HASTE fragments. Soft limbs grip wet rocks as waves break over its shell.
custom_pokedex_text_review.gKabuknightPokedexText: Its shell shields a soft blue body. It braces with its rear limbs, turning its armored front toward any approaching threat.
custom_pokedex_text_review.gAmunytePokedexText: Long thought extinct, it survives in flooded caves. Venom seeps from its purple growths, keeping predators away from its shell.
custom_pokedex_text_review.gKinkabutoPokedexText: It waits beneath the silt with its blades folded beside its shell. This ancient hunter strikes when prey stirs the water.
custom_pokedex_text_review.gAeropteryxPokedexText: It vaults from cliffs on folded wings. Warm air lifts this ancient dragon aloft. It returns to rock ledges when the air cools.
